title: Finger Pathway Atlas V4
scope: Representative connected anatomical model: 52 cutaneous tactile afferents, 8 free-ending nociceptive examples, 6 proprioceptive afferents, and 12 motor-unit examples with distinct relay cells. Every modeled cell is present in a single millimetre coordinate system. This is not a full biological cell census, measured connectome, histology/EM segmentation, or physiological simulation. Somata, caliber, dendrites, receptor structures, anatomical routes and synaptic assignments are reference-informed synthetic priors; the source plates are comparisons, not registration data. Conscious proprioceptive pathways and selected local collaterals are represented; cerebellar, autonomic, reticular and other collateral networks are outside this model.

morphology.basis: Reference-informed synthetic morphology; not an EM segmentation
morphology.dimensions: Local dimensions and placement are explicit model priors, not measurements from resized comparison plates.
morphology.meissner: Handler et al. 2023, PMC10773061: longitudinal, flattened terminal profiles, side protrusions and interdigitating support processes; cross-species structural analogue.
morphology.pacinian: Handler et al. 2023, PMC10773061: central ending with protrusions; interleaved inner support processes and closed outer lamellae.
morphology.drg: Human ganglion comparison plates 21–23: pseudounipolar soma, continuous stem, conformal satellite support; no dendrites or DRG synapse.
morphology.nmj: Jones et al. 2017, PMC5723673: varied, compact human endplates with separated receptor islands; not a copied mouse pretzel.
morphology.proprioception: PMC4811329: sheep extraocular spindle and tendon-organ analogues; neither a human finger reconstruction nor a human size calibration.
morphology.central: Multipolar spinal, cuneate and VPL class priors; simplified cortical pyramidal trees. Nissl profiles do not establish complete dendritic topology.

limitations: All cell identities, synapses, routes and shapes are constructed examples, not measured end-to-end human cells.
Source figures include different species, tissue sites and microscopy scales.
No cross sections or clipping planes; supplied gross skin retains its original upper-body crop.
Cortex intentionally simplified; autonomic, cerebellar, reticular and other collateral networks are outside this selected circuit.
Overview line widths are screen visibility cues; membrane coordinates and caliber priors use millimeters.
Local myelin uses bounded display patches. Nodal spacing and sheath ratio are model priors.
The original 50 comparison plates show V3 baseline model panels, not V4 screenshots.
